text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day at the study group—

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's keep going today. 
Development is finally reaching its 
climax, but...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: More and more... eager... Haa, whew...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
No, it's just that I've been feeling 
terribly exhausted lately...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Designing, developing, diving. I used to 
be fine, but the strain seems to be...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
“I see... Does that just mean the workload 
increased?”

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That ain't all. Operating high-spec gear 
demands a fair amount of stamina and 
focus, after all.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"A surging deluge of tears. To reach the 
river of salvation from there—"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...We might have no choice but to put you 
through training. Specifically, your 
physical body, Professor."

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: "Mine? Not ST-2's?"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes. With ST-2 reaching its second form 
and output increasing, the strain of the 
Full Dive has also increased accordingly.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
To withstand that strain, we must train 
the Professor's body as well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I see... strengthening the "body"—is it?

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
B-But I cannot move freely. Even if you 
say training...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: Trainer?
choice_data_list: If I assist, somehow we can manage it!

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
I-I see... If an expert like you is 
sticking with me, then...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Understood. This is part of the 
development process. I'll be counting on 
you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Dr. Reichts's personal training 
began, but...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh... As expected... this is tough. I 
never thought I'd be training in this body 
again, though...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Never thought I'd have to do this again... 
Though the weight is... lighter than 
before...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Since I can't dig my feet 
in, I have to manage somehow...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Are you hard at work, Professor, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S... Did you come to cheer me 
on?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: It's... not cheering.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I... made this.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: That's...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
It's the training menu. Trainer is right. 
But...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"There are some things only... an 
Umamusume can understand. Especially—when 
it comes to injuries."

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"So that's why you went out of your way to 
make a menu for me. Thank you."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S is certainly right; there's 
a lot I don't understand about how an 
Umamusume feels when carrying a handicap.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was truly grateful that supplementary 
training was suggested to me.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's do that next. If this body 
is worn out, I won't be able to operate 
ST-2 to its full potential either.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa... One... two...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
As expected of... Kris S's regimen. It's 
certainly... no joke...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
If it were the old me... I might have been 
able to handle this much... But...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
I won't... back down. Even if my strength 
hasn't returned, at least... my spirit...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Trainer... Thanks for... encouraging 
me...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Right, I've got to do my best, I... 
Guuuuh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As expected, Dr. Wright's stamina is 
considerably lower than that of an active 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, our feelings won't lose. Our 
desire to run with everything we've got 
through ST-2 will not be defeated."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Professor... It may be difficult right 
now, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "I believe. I believe――in overcoming it."

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Kris S. I can't say I never wonder 
how the old me would've handled it. 
However..."

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Those wounds healed long ago. Yes, right 
now, I am...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"For the future... I'm working hard solely 
for the future! There is only... hope!"

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
I will see this through! I'll create a 
Mecha Umamusume like no one ever has—

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
I will achieve it...! An unprecedented... 
invention! My... dream...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I see, Professor... You're also... That's 
why it's so...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: It's the same... They're so... alike...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I came to this country... to start a 
racing revolution.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Similar... To me, who came here 
shouldering a mission. And—"

text_block_list.name: Kris S's Master
text_block_list.text:
My mission, Kris S... is to spark a 
revolution in the Japanese racing world.

text_block_list.name: Kris S's Master
text_block_list.text:
For that sake... we are inviting 
world-class Umamusume from all over the 
globe to Japan.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: With Master... who found me and raised me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"The Doctor's mission is... the evolution 
of running. Or perhaps, that too is..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
We are—Same. Me with this body. The 
Professor with mecha.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Symboli Kris S found a common 
thread in Dr. Wright's dream. Yes—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's a mechanical body that runs, 
technology with a human touch will 
transform the very act of "running."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And after continuing on with her steady 
training—

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaahhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Ooooh...!

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
How's that, see! My stamina is still 
totally fine, and I'm not out of breath at 
all!

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
That's the result of our training. With 
this, she'll be just fine.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Good job. Doctor, we're one step 
closerâto the Revolution.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank you... Kris S!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Dr. Reichts gained the physical 
stamina needed to keep up with the new 
ST-2.
